records.claim: The Human Design BodyGraph represents activated gates and the connections between them; completed channels connect centres and contribute to chart definition.
records.locator: Section One, The Human Design BodyGraph, pp. 31-43; Section Two, The Nine Centers, pp. 44-103

records.claim: Chart definition is formed by completed channels and the centres they connect; the resulting defined structure is treated as a stable component of the natal design.
records.locator: Section Two, Definition in a BodyGraph, printed p. 34; Section Two, The Nine Centers

records.claim: The reference distinguishes defined centres from undefined and completely open centres, with definition represented by connected channel structure and openness represented by absence of complete channel definition.
records.locator: Section Two, The Nine Centers, especially pp. 51-52

records.claim: Strategy and Authority are presented as the Human Design decision-making framework, with different Authority forms associated with different chart configurations.
The reference presents four major Types and associates each with a corresponding Strategy for navigating interaction and decision-making.
records.locator: Section Four, The Four Types and Strategies, pp. 114-145

records.claim: A channel is formed by two gates and connects two centres; the reference describes 36 channels within the BodyGraph system.
records.locator: Section Six, Circuits, Channels and Gates, printed p. 159 and channel index

records.claim: The BodyGraph contains 64 gates, each functioning as an entry or exit point associated with the channel structure; the reference provides individual gate descriptions and line names.
records.locator: Section Six, Circuits, Channels and Gates, pp. 158-257

records.claim: Circuitry groups channels into broader energy-flow structures and is used as an interpretive framework for understanding how channel themes relate within the BodyGraph.
records.locator: Section Six, Circuits, Channels and Gates, pp. 158-159

records.claim: Profile is derived from the Personality Sun line and Design Sun line and is treated as a major component of the chart description.
records.locator: Section Five, Profiles, following the Types and Strategies section

records.claim: The reference frames Human Design knowledge as something to be tested through personal experience rather than accepted solely as an intellectual belief.
records.locator: Opening message from Ra Uru Hu, March 1, 2011
